title: Confession and Witness
author: Dominic Brightwater
blurb: Coral Quintana, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
